arxiv-2201-10277.title: Generation of travelling sine-Gordon breathers in noisy long Josephson junctions
arxiv-2201-10277.creator: Duilio De Santis, Claudio Guarcello, Bernardo Spagnolo, Angelo Carollo, Davide Valenti
arxiv-2201-10277.description: Abstract The generation of travelling sine-Gordon breathers is achieved through the nonlinear supratransmission effect in a magnetically driven long Josephson junction, in the presence of losses, a current bias, and a thermal noise source. We demonstrate how to exclusively induce breather modes by means of controlled magnetic pulses.

arxiv-2208-02420.title: New self-consistent effective one-body theory for spinless binaries based on the post-Minkowskian approximation
arxiv-2208-02420.creator: Jiliang Jing, Sheng Long, Weike Deng, Mengjie Wang, Jieci Wang
arxiv-2208-02420.description: Abstract The effective one-body theories, introduced by Buonanno and Damour, are novel approaches to constructing a gravitational waveform template. By taking a gauge in which ψ 1 B \psi_{1}^{B} and ψ 3 B \psi_{3}^{B} vanish, we find a decoupled equation with separable variables for ψ 4 B \psi^{B}_{4} for gravitational perturbation in the effective metric obtained in the post-Minkowskian approximation.

arxiv-2212-13148.title: Distribution of fast radio burst dispersion measures in CHIME/FRB Catalog 1: implications on the origin of FRBs
arxiv-2212-13148.creator: Jianwei Zhang, Chengmin Zhang, Di Li, Wuming Yang, Xianghan Cui, ChangQing Ye, Dehua Wang, Yiyan Yang, Shaolan Bi, Xianfei Zhang
arxiv-2212-13148.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jianwei Zhang, Chengmin Zhang, Di Li, Wuming Yang, Xianghan Cui, ChangQing Ye, Dehua Wang, Yiyan Yang, Shaolan Bi, Xianfei Zhang. Recently, CHIME/FRB project published its first fast radio burst (FRB) catalog (hereafter, Catalog 1), which totally contains 536 unique bursts.

arxiv-2304-00401.title: Canonical equivalence of a particle in a magnetic field to a simple oscillator
arxiv-2304-00401.creator: Henryk Gzyl
arxiv-2304-00401.description: Abstract It is proved that a classical (respec. quantum) system consisting of a particle in a constant magnetic field is canonically (respec. unitarily) equivalent to a 2-dimensional harmonic oscillator plus a free particle. It is also shown that the eigenvectors of the discrete spectrum are entangled states of the 2-dimensional harmonic oscillator.

arxiv-2305-04075.title: PointCMP: Contrastive Mask Prediction for Self-supervised Learning on Point Cloud Videos
arxiv-2305-04075.creator: Zhiqiang Shen, Xiaoxiao Sheng, Longguang Wang, Yulan Guo, Qiong Liu, Xi Zhou
arxiv-2305-04075.description: Abstract Self-supervised learning can extract representations of good quality from solely unlabeled data, which is appealing for point cloud videos due to their high labelling cost. In this paper, we propose a contrastive mask prediction (PointCMP) framework for self-supervised learning on point cloud videos.

arxiv-2310-15066.title: Localizing Active Objects from Egocentric Vision with Symbolic World Knowledge
arxiv-2310-15066.creator: Te-Lin Wu Yu Zhou Nanyun PengUniversity of California, Los Angeles {telinwu,violetpeng}@cs.ucla.edu, yu.zhou@ucla.edu
arxiv-2310-15066.description: Abstract The ability to actively ground task instructions from an egocentric view is crucial for AI agents to accomplish tasks or assist humans. One important step towards this goal is to localize and track key active objects that undergo major state change as a consequence of human actions/interactions in the environment ( e . g .

arxiv-2312-12708.title: Gradient flows for empirical Bayes in high-dimensional linear models
arxiv-2312-12708.creator: Zhou Fan, Leying Guan, Yandi Shen, Yihong Wu
arxiv-2312-12708.description: Abstract Empirical Bayes provides a powerful approach to learning and adapting to latent structure in data. Theory and algorithms for empirical Bayes have a rich literature for sequence models, but are less understood in settings where latent variables and data interact through more complex designs. In this work, we study empirical Bayes estimation of an i.i.d.

arxiv-2406-07728.title: Visibility-Aware RRT* for Safety-Critical Navigation of Perception-Limited Robots in Unknown Environments
arxiv-2406-07728.creator: Taekyung Kim, Dimitra Panagou
arxiv-2406-07728.description: Abstract Safe autonomous navigation in unknown environments remains a critical challenge for robots with limited sensing capabilities. While safety-critical control techniques, such as Control Barrier Functions (CBFs), have been proposed to ensure safety, their effectiveness relies on the assumption that the robot has complete knowledge of its surroundings.

britannica-1911-derbyshire.title: Derbyshire (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-derbyshire.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-derbyshire.description: Article 'Derbyshire' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 8), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The whole northward extension of the county is occupied by the plateau of the Peak and other plateau-like summits, the highest of which are of almost exactly similar elevation. Thus in the extreme north Bleaklow Hill reaches 2060 ft., while southward from this point along the axis of main elevation are found Shelf Moss (2046 ft.), and Kinder Scout and other summits of the Peak itself, ranging up to 2088 ft.

pmc-10594318.title: Length of antibiotic therapy among adults aged ≥65 years hospitalized with uncomplicated community-acquired pneumonia, 2013-2020
pmc-10594318.creator: Natalie McCarthy, Hannah Wolford, Sophia Kazakova, James Baggs, Brandon Attell, Sarah Kabbani, Melinda Neuhauser, Sarah Yi, Kelly Hatfield, Sujan Reddy, Lauri Hicks
pmc-10594318.description: Background: The 2014 US National Strategy for Combating Antibiotic-Resistant Bacteria aimed to reduce inappropriate inpatient antibiotic use by 20% for monitored conditions, such as community-acquired pneumonia (CAP), by 2020. Clinical guidelines recommend treating uncomplicated CAP with a minimum of 5 days of antibiotic therapy. Total length of therapy (LOT) >7 days or >3 days after clinical improvement is rarely necessary.

pmc-11310340.title: Robustness of highly complex radial carpet beams in turbulent atmospheres
pmc-11310340.creator: Saifollah Rasouli, Mohammad Bagheri, J. J. Niemela
pmc-11310340.description: In this study, we report observations of propagating radial carpet beams (RCBs) through a turbulent atmosphere at ground level with a 120 m path length. RCBs are a class of nondiffracting, accelerating, self-healing, and self-amplifying beams, and generated in the diffraction of a plane wave from amplitude/phase radial gratings having different spoke numbers.

pmc-11441703.title: Association of visceral adiposity index and lipid accumulation products with prediabetes in US adults from NHANES 2007–2020: A cross-sectional study
pmc-11441703.creator: Li-Ting Qiu, Ji-Dong Zhang, Bo-Yan Fan, Ling Li, Gui-Xiang Sun, Demitri Constantinou, Demitri Constantinou, Demitri Constantinou
pmc-11441703.description: BackgroundThe lipid accumulation product (LAP) and the visceral adiposity index (VAI) are suggested as dependable measures for assessing visceral fat levels. Prediabetes is recognized as a condition that precedes the potential onset of diabetes. The objective of this research is to investigate how VAI and LAP are related to prediabetes among the adult population in the United States.

pmc-11556285.title: When Non-Promising Findings Also Go From Aquarium to Bedside: The Importance of Rigorous Preclinical Analyses of ASM Candidates
pmc-11556285.creator: Sara Eyal
pmc-11556285.description: Testing of Putative Antiseizure Medications in a Preclinical Dravet Syndrome Zebrafish Model Whyte-Fagundes PA, Vance A, Carroll A, Figueroa F, Manukyan C, Baraban SC. Brain Commun. 2024;6(3):fcae135.Dravet syndrome is a severe genetic epilepsy primarily caused by de novo mutations in a voltage-activated sodium channel gene (SCN1A). Patients face life-threatening seizures that are largely resistant to available anti-seizure medications.

pmc-11565496.title: Invasive Fungal Laryngotracheitis Causing Laryngotracheal Separation
pmc-11565496.creator: Nazirah Baharudin, Vanitha Palanisamy, Mawaddah Azman, Kishanti Balachandran, Farhana Arif
pmc-11565496.description: Fungal laryngotracheitis (FLT) is rare, and the diagnosis can be challenging, as its presentation lacks specificity and may resemble other conditions such as granulomatous disease, gastroesophageal reflux, or malignancy. FLT can be very invasive, causing complete laryngotracheal separation, leading to a non-functioning larynx.

pmc-11574450.title: Connectivity‐Based Real‐Time Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging Neurofeedback in Nicotine Users: Mechanistic and Clinical Effects of Regulating a Meta‐Analytically Defined Target Network in a Double‐Blind Controlled Trial
pmc-11574450.creator: Arezoo Taebi, Klaus Mathiak, Benjamin Becker, Greta Kristin Klug, Jana Zweerings
pmc-11574450.description: One of the fundamental questions in real‐time functional magnetic resonance imaging neurofeedback (rt‐fMRI NF) investigations is the definition of a suitable neural target for training. Previously, we applied a meta‐analytical approach to define a network‐level target for connectivity‐based rt‐fMRI NF in substance use disorders.

pmc-11612297.title: Single nucleotide polymorphisms are associated with strain-specific virulence differences among clinical isolates of Cryptococcus neoformans
pmc-11612297.creator: Katrina M. Jackson, Thomas J. Y. Kono, Jovany J. Betancourt, Yina Wang, Kisakye D. Kabbale, Minna Ding, Perry Kezh, Grace Ha, J. Marina Yoder, Sophie R. Fulton, Liliane Mukaremera, Peter Tiffin, Asiya Gusa, David B. Meya, R. Blake Billmyre, Chaoyang Xue, Kirsten Nielsen
pmc-11612297.description: Studies across various pathogens highlight the importance of pathogen genetic differences in disease manifestation. In the human fungal pathogen Cryptococcus neoformans, sequence type (ST) associates with patient outcome. We performed a meta-analysis of four genomic studies and identified overlapping gene regions associated with virulence, suggesting the importance of these gene regions in cryptococcal disease in diverse clinical isolates.

pmc-11652301.title: Digital Papillary Adenocarcinoma: A Case Presentation and Literature Review
pmc-11652301.creator: Haley F. Pate, David B. Fulton
pmc-11652301.description: Digital papillary adenocarcinoma is a rare cutaneous tumor of eccrine origin that often presents as a papule or nodule on the dorsal aspect of a finger. It is challenging to diagnose because of its rarity, its benign appearance, and the lack of specific clinical or histological features.

pmc-12388957.title: Reactions of Surface-Confined Terminal Alkynes Mediated by Diverse Regulation Strategies
pmc-12388957.creator: Yun Wu, Lei Xu, Junxi Li, Chi Zhang, Paolo M Scrimin
pmc-12388957.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Terminal alkynes, characterized by sp-hybridized carbon atoms at the molecular termini, possess high electron density and exceptional chemical reactivity. These properties make them ideal candidates for the synthesis of one-dimensional molecular wires and two-dimensional networks. Advances in nanoscale characterization techniques, such as scanning tunneling microscopy and atomic force microscopy, have enabled the real-space visualization of molecular assembly and chemical reactions of terminal alkynes and in situ atomic-level manipulations under surface-confined conditions.

pmc-12401061.title: Transplanted Iron Oxide Nanoparticle-Labeled Mesenchymal Stem Cells Exhibit ex vivo Neuronal Firing Activity in Ischemic Stroke Rats
pmc-12401061.creator: Dong-Ming Huang, Chen-Wen Lu, Jong-Kai Hsiao
pmc-12401061.description: PurposeMesenchymal stem cell (MSC) therapy shows promise in preclinical ischemic stroke models, yet clinical translation remains inconsistent. To address this gap, we investigated whether labeling MSCs with Ferucarbotran enables magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) tracking and enhances neural differentiation and functional integration, particularly focusing on the novel observation of spontaneous neuronal firing activity in transplanted cells.

pmc-12836917.title: Mortality differences in coronary patients with breast cancer treated with trimetazidine dihydrochloride: potential therapeutic implications
pmc-12836917.creator: Yuen-Ting Cheng, Chun-Fung Sin, Edmond S. K. Ma, Stephen T. S. Lam, Bernard MY Cheung, Kai-Hang Yiu, Hung-Fat Tse, Yap-Hang Chan
pmc-12836917.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundTrimetazidine, an anti-angina drug with metabolic regulatory effects, has been observationally associated with reduced malignancy risk. However, whether it has clinical implications for established breast cancer is unknown.MethodsWe retrospectively studied 2,526 patients with pre-existing or de novo breast cancer and ischemic heart disease (IHD) who received trimetazidine therapy or oral nitrate, identified from the Hong Kong Clinical Data Analysis and Reporting System (CDARS) between January 1, 1999, and December 31, 2020. Subjects were classified as trimetazidine users (n=169) versus non-users (n=2,357).

pmc-13031768.title: Design and development of ultra-broadband THz metamaterial MIMO antenna with efficient diversity parameters optimized with machine learning for TWPAN applications
pmc-13031768.creator: Meshari Alsharari, Yogesh Sharma, Khaled Aliqab, Ammar Armghan, S. K. Patel, Aymen Flah
pmc-13031768.description: The high-speed communication development is revolutionizing the way with interact with technology by enabling ultra-fast and intelligent connectivity. There is a need for antenna design that operates with ultrabroadband in the THz regime to be applicable for Terahertz Wireless Persona Area Network (TWPAN) applications.

pmc-13244151.title: WSTF deficiency reprograms regulatory networks by linking locus–specific chromatin remodeling to altered isoform expression and misdirected signaling
pmc-13244151.creator: Shahin Behrouz Sharif, Jonathan H Dennis
pmc-13244151.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Loss of the chromatin remodeler WSTF (BAZ1B), a gene deleted in Williams syndrome, causes reproducible, genome-scale reprogramming of chromatin states and transcript processing that links altered chromatin composition to misprocessed transcripts and aberrant signaling. Using engineered HCT116-WSTFKO cells, we combine transcriptome profiling, microscopy, chromatin CUT&RUN, and histone post-translational modification (HPTM)-defined chromatin state modeling to show that WSTF localizes to promoters and gene bodies of actively transcribed loci together with ASH2L and CBP.

pmc-13409936.title: Hexaconazole-Induced Male Reproductive Toxicity Through ROS-Mediated Ferroptosis and Impaired Leydig Cell Steroidogenesis
pmc-13409936.creator: Ran Lee, Hyeon Woo Sim, Won-Young Lee, Hyun-Jung Park
pmc-13409936.description: Triazole fungicides are ubiquitous environmental contaminants. However, their specific effects on the male reproductive system remain unclear. We investigated the toxicological effects of hexaconazole (HEX) on testicular function and elucidated its underlying molecular mechanisms. Although 8 weeks of HEX administration in mice did not affect body weight or gross testicular morphology, it significantly reduced sperm motility and circulating testosterone levels.

pmc-13436053.title: How Well Are Dental Students Equipped to Handle Traumatic Dental Injuries in Children?
pmc-13436053.creator: Sobia Zafar, Luan Lin Jovita Cheong, Vonn Ler, Anastasia Min Teh, Paul Abbott
pmc-13436053.description: To evaluate dental students' knowledge and confidence in managing dental trauma (TDI). An observational questionnaire‐based study involving fourth‐year BDSc (Hons) students from 2022 and 2023 at UQ, following their Traumatic Dental Injury module. A 44‐item questionnaire assessed knowledge in managing TDI in primary dentition and fractures, subluxations and avulsion of permanent teeth. Confidence was self‐reported.

pmc-13562767.title: Body Posture‐Related Differences in Pain Perception and Their Mediation by Cardiovascular Factors
pmc-13562767.creator: Gustavo A. Reyes del Paso, Dolores Santiago, Belén Moreno, Casandra I. Montoro, Stefan Duschek, Dmitry M. Davydov
pmc-13562767.description: Pain modulation arising from the cardiovascular system has repeatedly been described. It is mediated by the baroreceptor system, where the activity of baroreceptor afferents inhibits nociception. Body posture changes cause blood volume redistribution that might modulate baroreceptor activity and antinociceptive effects. This study investigated posture‐related differences in pain perception and their causation by cardiovascular factors.
